question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard capabilities remain a sponsored bundled dashboard plugin/control-plane roadmap, and which child items should move to plugin or ClawHub distribution instead?
rationale: The tracker spans persistent workspace/widget state, public Control UI/plugin APIs, untrusted browser code, registry/install trust, and role visibility boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor Selectively
options.body: Keep this roadmap open and review linked child issues and PRs one by one with explicit storage and security boundaries before merge.

options.title: Move Optional Pieces Outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and route optional widget packs, skills, registries, or app bundles to plugins or ClawHub.

options.title: Defer Wave 2+
options.body: Pause this roadmap if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Selectively
recommendation.body: Keep this roadmap open and review linked child issues and PRs one by one with explicit storage and security boundaries before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and related product/security boundary.
